title.ar: الفصل 25 — الرجل اللي ورا كل إشي

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هاي القصة صعب عليّ أكتبها، لأنها آخر قصة.
sentences.en: This story is hard for me to write, because it is the last.

sentences.ar: بربيع سنة 1891، كنت متزوج، وشغلي كتير، وما شفت هولمز أشهر.
sentences.en: In the spring of 1891, I was married, my practice busy, and I had not seen Holmes for months.

sentences.ar: وبليلة من أبريل، دخل على عيادتي، بلا موعد، ووجهه أبيض، وأنحف من قبل.
sentences.en: And one April night, he came into my consulting room, without appointment, his face pale, thinner than before.

sentences.ar: وأول شي عمله، سكر مصاريع الشباك.
sentences.en: And the first thing he did was close the window shutters.
I said: are you afraid of something?
He said: of air-guns.

sentences.ar: ورفع إيده، وكانت مجروحة ومغطاة بالدم.
sentences.en: And raised his hand, and it was cut and covered with blood.
He said: I am not a man who imagines things.

sentences.ar: بس الليلة حاولوا يقتلوني تلات مرات.
sentences.en: But tonight they tried to kill me three times.

sentences.ar: قال: واطسون، سمعت باسم البروفيسور موريارتي؟
sentences.en: He said: Watson, have you heard the name of Professor Moriarty?
I said: no.
He said: and that is his genius.
All London has not heard of him.
A mathematician, from a good family.

sentences.ar: كتب كتاب بعمر واحد وعشرين ما حدا فهمه بأوروبا.
sentences.en: He wrote a book at twenty-one no one in Europe understood.

sentences.ar: وصار أستاذ بجامعة، وبعدين طلع منها، بسبب إشاعات، وإجا على لندن.
sentences.en: And became a professor at a university, and then left it, over rumours, and came to London.

sentences.ar: ومن سنين، أنا حاسس إن ورا كل جريمة كبيرة بلندن، في عقل واحد.
sentences.en: And for years, I have felt that behind every big crime in London, there is one mind.
Theft, forgery, murder.

sentences.ar: كلها مختلفة، وكلها مرتبة بنفس الطريقة.
sentences.en: All different, all arranged the same way.

sentences.ar: وهو بيقعد بمكانه، زي العنكبوت بنص الشبكة، وما بيتحرك.
sentences.en: And he sits in his place, like a spider at the centre of the web, and does not move.
But he feels every thread.

sentences.ar: قال: وأنا، من تلات أشهر، عم أنسج شبكة حوالي شبكته.
sentences.en: He said: and I, for three months, have been weaving a net around his net.

sentences.ar: وبعد تلات أيام، الشرطة بتسكر الشبكة، وبيمسكوه هو وكل عصابته.
sentences.en: And in three days, the police close the net, and take him and his whole gang.
And he knows.

sentences.ar: اليوم الصبح، وأنا بأوضتي، انفتح الباب، ووقف قدامي.
sentences.en: This morning, in my room, the door opened, and he stood before me.

sentences.ar: طويل، ونحيف، وجبينه كبير، وعينه غايرة.
sentences.en: Tall, thin, a great forehead, sunken eyes.

sentences.ar: وراسه بيتحرك يمين شمال زي الحية.
sentences.en: And his head moving side to side like a snake's.

sentences.ar: وقال: عندك جبين أقل مما توقعت.
sentences.en: And said: you have less frontal development than I expected.

sentences.ar: وحط إيدك على مسدسك بجيبك خطر.
sentences.en: And it is dangerous to keep your hand on a revolver in your pocket.
And I put the revolver on the table.

sentences.ar: قال موريارتي: إنت عارف إني عارف.
sentences.en: Moriarty said: you know that I know.
And I know that you know.
On the fourth of January you crossed me.
On the twenty-third you incommoded me.
By the middle of February you seriously inconvenienced me.
And now, because of you, I am in real danger.
Holmes said: and then?
Moriarty said: withdraw.

sentences.ar: إنت رجل ذكي، وبيسعدني أحكي معك.
sentences.en: You are a clever man, and it pleases me to talk with you.
But if you do not withdraw, I destroy you.
Holmes said: and if I destroy you?

sentences.ar: قال موريارتي: بيصير واحد فينا فوق التاني.
sentences.en: Moriarty said: then one of us is on top of the other.
And I am not used to being underneath.
And he left.
And that same day, a cart nearly ran me down.

sentences.ar: وحجر وقع من سطح جنب راسي، ورجل هجم عليّ بعصا.
sentences.en: And a brick fell from a roof beside my head, and a man attacked me with a cudgel.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: تلات أيام يا واطسون.
sentences.en: Holmes said: three days, Watson.
I must vanish for three days.
Come with me to the Continent.
